validation.rustfmt: passed for all touched Rust API, worker, unit-test, and C++ host integration-test files
validation.git_diff_check: passed for llm-sandbox worker/tests, Rust policy/host, regenerated capability catalogs, and evidence/docs

limitations: Python class/module-function, C ABI and the external JSONL checkpoint protocol are covered; third-party process conformance, general Rust trait strategy state recovery, complete per-hook capability refusal, all host pairs for every callback, cross-backend cursor fencing, and full multi-worker persistence remain open W3 work. Strategy checkpoint/cursor persistence is not a global transaction with external order-command stores.
Dynamic C++ validation used the locally built example plugin and does not prove third-party plugin deployment behavior.
Real E2B, Microsandbox, OpenSandbox, or remote Docker llm-sandbox isolation, capacity, cost, and long-session recovery remain unverified.
release_status: unpublished workspace; W3 and release gates remain open
